conviction_note: The findings sum to +0.7. That is three proxy positives (Amazon's spend and Trainium commitments, Celestica's 2027 guide, and the setup: a 38% fall in 20 days with no company news, against an August reaction that followed a run-up) set against a margin step-down, a Microsoft capex cut and the insider overhang. The scaled number is p_up 53 x abs 13 = +0.78. The beats-sold history and a modest put skew (+6.2 vol points) keep p_up near 50. The fundamental read (+4% revenue beat, in line with the last two quarters' pattern) is much stronger than the reaction read, because this name has sold three straight beats and the stock trades on the Q4 guide, whose ~$656m bar has only one source.
bar: Q3 revenue: company guide $540-560m (Q2 8-K, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001736297/000173629726000033/q226exhibit991.htm). Consensus is about $551m and $1.19 non-GAAP EPS, from two agreeing sources: TIKR, updated 2026-11-02 (https://www.tikr.com/blog/astera-labs-stock-fell-after-its-last-3-revenue-beats-heres-what-could-change-on-nov-3), and finwire/Invezz on 2026-11-03, $550m and $1.19 (https://finwire.io/news/stock-markets-news/astera-labs-stock-crashed-below-a-key-support-level-will-it-recover-after-earnings). Q4 revenue consensus is about $656m, from one source only (TIKR, same URL). A second TIKR piece puts the Q4 guide needed to hold the $1.91B FY26 estimate at $648-668m, so the guidance findings are capped small. Some aggregators print $0.22 EPS, which is GAAP after the Amazon warrant contra-revenue and SBC; it is not the trading bar.
positioning_check: Short interest 8,015,331 shares, 5.16% of float, 1.8 days to cover, as of 2026-10-15 (FINRA, published 2026-10-26), down 12.66% from 9,176,900. Source: https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/ALAB/short-interest/. Not a crowded short. Baseline: 25-delta skew +6.23 vol points (downside paid, moderate), put/call OI 0.55 (calls heavier), ATM IV 159%, event-implied move 11.55%, straddle 13.29%. finwire on 2026-11-03 reports the largest call OI at $250 and puts at $220. Tape: -16.1% in 5 days, -38.3% in 20 days, -50% from the 52-week high. Director Dyckerhoff sold on 2026-10-07 at $376.06, so the stock has fallen about 36% from there in four weeks.

findings.finding: Amazon's Q3 2026 report (2026-10-29) kept 2026 cash capex at about $220B. Jassy said Amazon expects to spend 'meaningfully more in 2027', the chips business is growing at triple-digit rates, and Trainium revenue commitments are up more than 20x year on year. Amazon holds a purchase-vesting warrant on up to $6.5B of Astera products and is very likely Astera's largest customer (Customer A is 29% of Q2 revenue in the 10-Q). This supports a Q4 guide at or above the ~$656m bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The guide line has not paid recently. In August a guide of $540-560m against $410m consensus (+34%) still fell 11.96% over the window, after a +20%/+12.7% run-in (Trefis). In February the stock fell 21.41%.
findings.why_not_priced: The market read Amazon's print as an AI-ROI worry: ALAB fell 10.9-11.7% on 2026-10-30, about four times the Nasdaq, with no company news (TIKR). If the demand read-through were priced, ALAB would have held up against the semis tape. It went the other way. Whether Astera's Q4 guide carries Trainium3 volume is first visible on the call.
findings.independence: Amazon's demand statements also appear in the datastudios Q3 write-up (https://www.datastudios.org/post/amazon-q3-2026-results-aws-39-percent-growth-46-billion-220-billion-capex). Astera's own Q2 10-Q shows vested Amazon warrant shares accelerating from 1,165,513 (Dec) to 1,331,902 (Mar) to 1,663,042 (Jun), which tracks Amazon purchases (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001736297/000173629726000035/alab-20260630.htm). That is a separate document but the same customer. The transmission from Amazon capex to Astera's Q4 is a proxy.

findings.finding: Celestica, a major hyperscaler AI-rack assembler, reported Q3 2026 revenue of $5.83B on 2026-10-26, above its $5.25-5.55B guide, with CCS up 102%. It guided Q4 to $6.275-6.575B and set a first 2027 outlook of about $40B (+90%), saying customers' 2028 forecasts are meaningfully higher. That is a broad, current AI-hardware demand read for the rack programmes Astera's switches and retimers go into.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no clean history of ALAB reacting to Celestica. ALAB fell about 11% in the week after this print, so the market did not pass it through.
findings.why_not_priced: ALAB is down 38% in 20 days while a direct supply-chain peer guided 2027 up 90%. Had the read-through been priced, ALAB's drawdown would not sit beside a peer raising its outlook. The market treated ALAB as AI beta, not as a demand read.
findings.independence: This is a different company and document from the Amazon finding but the same end-demand theme. Celestica does not name Astera, so this is a proxy.

findings.finding: Microsoft now expects calendar-2026 capex of about $170B, down from its earlier outlook (about $190B in earlier guidance), because third-party data-center capacity is delayed. This is a negative datapoint for the AI-hardware supply chain, though Microsoft is not confirmed as a top Astera customer.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None specific to ALAB. It arrived in the same Oct 29-30 window as ALAB's -11% day.
findings.why_not_priced: It is largely priced: it was part of the Oct 29-30 AI selloff. It is filed so the set nets the Amazon and Celestica positives against the one hyperscaler that cut. It matters only if Astera's Q4 guide shows a non-Amazon customer slowing.
findings.independence: Same HL/Business Insider article as the Amazon finding (one document, two facts pointing in opposite directions). The earlier ~$190B Microsoft figure is from search snippets (Luminix, https://www.useluminix.com/reports/industry-analysis/hyperscaler-capex-q3-2026/source/4).

findings.finding: The setup is the reverse of August. Then the stock rose about 20% on 2026-07-30 and 12.7% on print day before falling 12%; Trefis wrote that 'the rally came first'. This time it goes in down 38.3% in 20 days and 16.1% in 5, about 50% below its high, with no company-specific news (TIKR 2026-10-20 and 2026-11-03; the semis selloff took Credo -14% and Marvell -11% in one October week). It trades at 46x forward earnings, near the bottom of its range (March low 41x, one-year average 72x).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The three most recent prints (Feb -21.4%, May -0.8%, Aug -12.0%) were all sold. Aug 2025 (+28.7%) came after a weak tape; ALAB moved up on only 2 of its last 7 prints.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced by construction, since the drawdown is the price. The point is that the 'beats get sold' prior in the baseline was measured after run-ups, and this print comes after a run-down. If the market expected a clean guide, the stock would not have fallen 36% since 2026-10-07 on sector news. The put skew is only moderate (+6.2), and put/call OI of 0.55 does not show heavy protection demand.
findings.independence: TIKR (https://www.tikr.com/blog/astera-labs-fell-harder-than-the-market-in-the-ai-selloff-heres-what-november-3-must-show) gives the 46x forward multiple and the no-company-news attribution. Lesson 5 caps an unexplained drawdown at 0, but this one has a documented sector cause, so the finding is kept small.

findings.finding: The Q2 2026 10-Q shows work-in-progress inventory nearly tripled, from $35.8m (Dec 2025) to $98.7m (Jun 2026), with total inventory at $113.8m. Vested Amazon warrant shares rose 1.17M to 1.33M to 1.66M over two quarters. Both corroborate the guided Q3 Scorpio X ramp. The inventory build also explains why Q2 free cash flow, $67.2m, was about half the prior-year level.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 revenue beat the guide midpoint by about 9% and the stock fell 12%. Ramp corroboration of this kind has not been paid.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the result sits inside what the company guided ($540-560m). It is filed because it tells against a Q3 shortfall, and an inventory build of this size would be visible as a write-down risk if the ramp had slipped.
findings.independence: TIKR 2026-10-20 reports Q2 FCF of $67.2m, about half the prior year (https://www.tikr.com/de/blog/astera-labs-lost-11-in-a-week-stifel-sees-60-upside-from-here). That is the same fact seen through cash flow, so the two are merged into this finding.

findings.finding: Gross margin is stepping down. Non-GAAP GM was guided to about 72% for Q3, against 73.7% in Q2 and 76.3% in Q1, and the CFO has said margins trend 'down towards the 70% range' as hardware modules and Scorpio grow and the Amazon warrant contra-revenue grows ($10.2m in Q2, against $2.1m in 1H25). A Q4 GM guide below 72% is the likely flashpoint.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: In August the GM guide fell from about 74% to 72% and the stock fell 12% the next session. Trefis attributes that move to the run-up rather than the margin.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus models about 72.6% GM for 2026 (TIKR), above where the CFO says margins are heading. A high-60s or roughly 70% Q4 GM guide would be under that, and the multiple has nowhere to hide if the narrative becomes 'hardware-ization'.
findings.independence: The Q2 8-K gives the 72% guide and the 73.7% actual (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001736297/000173629726000033/q226exhibit991.htm). The Q2 10-Q gives the warrant contra-revenue of $10.2m. Three documents, one line.

findings.finding: Insider selling is a persistent overhang. In six months there were 295 insider sales and 0 purchases, including President/COO Gajendra (about $238m), director Alba (about $132m) and CEO Mohan (about $84m). Director Dyckerhoff sold on 2026-10-07 at $376.06 under a 10b5-1 plan.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This is cited as a cause of post-print weakness in August (MarketBeat) and in October, without a measured effect.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced, being public Form 4s. The open-window resumption after the print gives post-print strength a supply of stock. Insiders who sold at $376 also add to the 'sell the bounce' reflex.
findings.independence: A Zacks/ad-hoc mention of about $122.6m of insider sales over three months, via the first search's summary (https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/price-astera-labs-nasdaq-alab-stock-falls-17-heres-what-happened-2026-10-02/). It is aggregated data from the same Form 4s.

findings.finding: Astera habitually beats its own guide. Q2 revenue was $392.4m against a $355-365m guide (+9% on the midpoint) and non-GAAP EPS $0.80 against $0.68-0.70 (+16%). Q3 consensus sits at the $551m guide midpoint and $1.19 EPS, so the reported quarter will likely clear it; a repeat of the Q2 pattern implies about $590m. The beat is the expected outcome, not a surprise.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The last three revenue beats were all sold: -21.4%, -0.8% and -12.0% (TIKR headline 'Stock Fell After Its Last 3 Revenue Beats').
findings.why_not_priced: The published consensus at the midpoint understates the habitual beat. The buy side expects a beat, though, and the reaction history says a beat alone does not move the stock up. The finding is kept small for that reason.
findings.independence: The Q2 actuals are in the Q2 8-K (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001736297/000173629726000033/q226exhibit991.htm).

outside_window.finding: Amazon's Trainium4 reportedly adopts NVLink Fusion and UALink, moving away from the PCIe-based design that used Scorpio in Trainium3. This is a content-mix risk for 2027-28 that no Q4 number can settle.

searched_and_found_nothing: A company-specific cause for the October drawdown: none found. TIKR and Quiver attribute it to the sector selloff, insider sales and an unnamed downgrade (the Northland downgrade to hold, early October).
A Trainium3 pushout or Scorpio share-loss report from October 2026: none found. The only Trainium3 shipment-cut rumours are from March 2026 (DIGITIMES).
New Astera customer or design-win press releases in October 2026: none found.
The Credo and Marvell schedules: neither reported since Astera last spoke (Credo early Sept, Marvell late Aug), so there is no fresh scale-up read.
Nasdaq's short-interest API returned 503; MarketBeat's FINRA-sourced figure was used instead.
Buy-side whisper numbers: none sourced (Earnings Whispers $0.83 is stale or GAAP-mixed).

rejected_candidates.candidate: AMD reports Q3 the same evening (amc 2026-11-03), with a UALink and scale-up read-through.
rejected_candidates.detail: The outcome is unknowable before the print. There is no sourced fact about what AMD will say; the sweep row flags it as an in-window coincident catalyst.

rejected_candidates.candidate: The 'AMD-Oracle deal sends shockwaves through Astera' and the Barclays downgrade to equal weight (UALink shift).
rejected_candidates.detail: Finviz dates the Barclays item 2025-10-28, and the AMD-Oracle item is the October 2025 deal. These are year-old stories relabelled, not 2026 events.
The company guided GAAP EPS to $0.87-0.92 and non-GAAP to $1.16-1.21 (Q2 8-K). $0.22 matches neither and is a data-feed artefact, not the bar.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Analyst targets: Stifel buy $460, Citi buy $430 (2026-10-27), TD Cowen hold $375 to $300, mean about $388.
rejected_candidates.detail: This is wire consensus; its content is folded into the positioning and valuation finding rather than filed separately.

baseline_tension: The small net positive cuts mildly against the +6.2 put skew. It agrees with the -38% run-down being a de-rating rather than information: the drawdown came on documented sector news, and put/call OI of 0.55 is call-heavy. p_up is held at 53 because the name has sold three straight beats.
lessons_applied: Lesson 6: the Q4 bar ($656m) has one source, so the guidance-dependent Amazon finding was capped from +1.0 to +0.7. Celestica went from +0.5 to +0.4 for the same reason.
Lesson 5: positioning/drawdown inference cut from +1.5 to +0.7. A drawdown with no company cause is close to 0, but this one has a documented sector cause (TIKR, CNBC), so it was kept small.
Lessons 1 and 6: the habitual beat lands on the reported quarter of a name that sold its last three beats, and inside the company's own guide, so it was cut from +0.8 to +0.5.
Lesson 7: the sign is mildly against a +6.2 skew. Short interest of 5.16% and 1.8 days to cover means no squeeze case for the negatives. p_up went from 54 to 53.
Lesson 9: the Amazon finding is one customer (about 29%). The Microsoft capex cut was kept as the offsetting non-Amazon datapoint, unchanged at -0.5.
Left standing: the gross margin finding (-1.0), insider overhang (-0.3), inventory/WIP (+0.2) and abs_move 13.
